themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents capable of performing multi-step research tasks autonomously, interacting with tools, and making decisions.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses AI-powered platforms and applications designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles on AI applications directly supporting the design and user research processes, including idea generation and hypothesis testing.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content focused on assessing the utility, effectiveness, and suitability of AI tools for specific UX and research tasks.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around AI-generated personas or data that simulate user behavior for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to analyze user data, extract insights, and identify patterns.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing job roles, creating new opportunities, and impacting employment in research and design fields.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Articles focused on AI's capability to create various forms of content, such as text, images, or code.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
